g.title: handleInit, archiveWorkForInit, loadVerifiedBundledMetadata, validateMetadata, and inspectArchive select the target, acquire and verify candidate bytes, invoke installCandidate, and prepare truthful planned/actual installation results. General command dispatch remains MOD-010 responsibility in this shared file.
The closed codex/claude descriptor map defines supported target names, .agents/skills or .claude/skills placement, and target archive naming.

candidateUnits and installCandidate preflight exact candidate units, preserve unrelated units, require explicit force for conflicts, publish verified files, and return completed/retained/failed scope. The descriptor-relative filesystem mechanism has explicit capability requirements.
Validates the selected official archive URL before network acquisition; a locally supplied ZIP still uses the package-bundled metadata trust basis.
